set.body:
Add high-value anatomical capabilities after backend admission. Represent curvature as an ordinary typed scalar SurfaceField with a documented underlay encoding so curvature computed on folded geometry can display on topology-compatible inflated geometry. Derive parcel/ROI boundaries from MeshTopology and LabeledSurface without duplicating graph state. Add typed world-space clipping planes with explicit keep-side semantics and backend capability checks. Add deterministic publication presets and high-resolution snapshots with legends and orientation annotations compiled through graphics Scene.

Acceptance: curvature topology mismatch is rejected; boundary edges match parcel fixtures; clipping is consistent in reference, JavaFX, and browser backends or explicitly capability-gated; publication snapshots include reproducible camera/layer receipts; all new behavior has JVM/JS shared tests and live backend visual checks.
set.title: Surface anatomical display: curvature, parcel outlines, clipping, and publication output
